newsitem.title: INDIA: India increases states' power project authority. [Corrected 7:48 gmt]
newsitem.headline: India increases states' power project authority. [Corrected 7:48 gmt]

text.p: The Indian government has decided to allow state governments to have sole responsibility for approving foreign direct investment in the power industry sector for projects up to (corrects from "over") 10 billion rupees, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said on Tuesday.

"In the power sector, which we want to simplify, up to (corrects from "above") 10 billion rupees, we want to delegate to states directly and there is no need to come to the centre (federal government) or Central Electricity Authority," Deve Gowda told a conference on foreign investment.
He said in the last five years India had made no significant improvements in the power sector. He said the delegation of authority to the states would be announced formally in the next week.
